periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45-degree downward tilt toward the muzzle relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Vertical ovoid with an elongated height-to-width ratio.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Distinct downward teardrop-shaped taper extending significantly below the geometric center.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation on the cranial crown, roughly equivalent to the width of the forehead.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Regular semicircular curvature with smooth, rounded tops.

other_distinctive_markers: Seated posture with mouth open, exposing visible dentition and oral cavity.
